text:
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help you with both changing the address to 445 Maple Drive and swapping the jigsaw puzzle to the easier 500-piece beginner version for your child. The $7.98 refund will be processed to your PayPal account.

Have a great day, and I hope your child enjoys the puzzle!
zh:
不客气！我很高兴能帮你把地址改成445 Maple Drive，以及把拼图换成更适合你孩子的500片入门级版本。$7.98的退款将处理到你的PayPal账户。

祝你有美好的一天，希望你的孩子喜欢这个拼图！
